name: A daily dose of ANXIETY!
source:
You meet 17 years old boy who is struggling with horrible anxiety.
Tobias is a very talented artist, coming from not-very-rich family
his parents don't really care about him after he told them about his problems.
He tried many times to show people how he really feels.
No one cared anyway.
He was born as a failure.
It's not his fault, isn't it?

[From [url=https://5tr4ngr.itch.io/a-daily-dose-of-anxiety]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你遇到了一位正在与可怕的焦虑作斗争的17岁男孩。
托比亚斯是一位非常有才华的艺术家，来自不太富裕的家庭
在他告诉父母他的问题后，他的父母并不真正关心他。
他多次尝试向人们展示他的真实感受。
反正没人关心。
他生来就是一个失败者。
这不是他的错，不是吗？

[来自[url=https://5tr4ngr.itch.io/a-daily-dose-of-anxiety]Itch.io[/url]]
